newsitem.title: USA: Hilton Hotels to issue $325 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Hilton Hotels to issue $325 mln in debt.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp is expected to issue a $325 million seven-year debt offering via joint lead managers Merrill Lynch & Co, Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities and JP Morgan Securities, dealers said on Wednesday.
Hilton's issue is expected to carry a coupon reset provision in the event of a downgrade to the credit, dealers said.
"The deal has reset language in it ... if the issue gets downgraded the coupon gets adjusted," said one syndicate source.
However, analysts said the provision is likely to go unused as such a downgrade would be extremely unlikely given Hilton's deep committment to investment grade ratings.
Hilton's upcoming issue is rated Baa1/BBB-plus.
